STUDIO / BORN IN TRONDHEIM, NORWAY

From Trondheim.
On your team.

We’re Shubham and Rajiv. We started The Red Studio in Trondheim to help people give their ideas a clear shape. Researchers are at the centre of our work; local businesses, independent bands and brands are welcome, too.

You know the research.
We help it connect.

We’re interested in the space between a good idea and the people who need to understand it. That might mean a website for a research project, a conference poster, an animated explanation or an edited interview.

You bring the knowledge and check the scientific meaning. We bring structure, design and a fresh pair of eyes. We ask questions before making things look good.

Our Trondheim roots matter to us. We want a working relationship that feels local: approachable people, straightforward conversations and care for the details.

ILLUSTRATIVE WORKFLOW / NOT A CLIENT PROJECT

A clear process.
Nothing hidden.

You see how it’s made.

We share early work and explain our choices. Sources and any proposed AI assistance are discussed openly. Your research stays yours to check and approve.

Care with your data.

We can work with sample data first. Before handling sensitive files, we agree who can access them, which tools we use and when they’re deleted. Read our approach ↗

Transparent by default.

You get the scope, cost, timeline, feedback rounds and final file list in writing. Extra work needs an approved price before we start. No surprise additions. See our prices ↗
